# Memory Instructions
You have a memory folder in .github/memory.
This folder is used to store context and history for your sessions.
You can read, write, and delete files in this folder to maintain state across sessions.
You can also use this folder to store important information that you want to remember for future sessions.
# Memory Usage Guidelines
- Use the memory folder to store context and history for your sessions.
- Read and write files in this folder to maintain state across sessions.
- Store important information that you want to remember for future sessions.
- Use the memory folder to keep track of your progress and any important notes.
- Do not delete files in the memory folder unless you are sure you no longer need them.
- Use descriptive file names to make it easier to find information later.
- Store files in a structured way to make it easier to navigate.
- For memory files related to java code:
 organize memory files by java packages or modules with a memory file created for each class file to keep related information together.
 - Always check your memory folder for relevant context before starting a new session.
